question: Who do you write a school leave application to? 🏫
explanation: Awesome! We write a formal leave application to the Principal or our teacher! 🏫
hint: Think of the head of your school.

question: How do we start a formal letter to a teacher? 📝
explanation: Super! We always use respectful words like 'Respected Madam' or 'Sir' for teachers! 🌟
hint: Choose the most polite greeting.

question: What comes right after 'To' at the start? 📍
explanation: Great job! We write 'The Principal' to show exactly who the letter is for! 📍
hint: Who is the boss of the school?

question: What is the 'Subject' of a letter for? 🎯
explanation: Fantastic! The subject tells the reader the main reason for your letter in one quick look! 📖
hint: It tells them 'why' you are writing.

question: How long should the 'Subject' line be? 📏
explanation: Awesome! A subject line should be short and very easy to understand! ⚡
hint: Keep it tiny and to the point.

question: What do we write in the 'Body' of the letter? 📝
explanation: Super! The body holds all the important details and the whole message! 💬
hint: This is the main story part of the letter.

question: Which one is a perfect formal closing? 🖋️
explanation: Great job! 'Yours obediently' is a very polite and respectful way to end a school letter! 🎩
hint: It sounds very neat and proper.

question: What is another polite way to close a letter? 📜
explanation: Brilliant! 'Yours faithfully' is a smart and formal way to close your application! 🌟
hint: It has the word 'faithfully' in it.

question: What goes at the very end of your application? ✍️
explanation: Awesome! You must sign your name so the Principal knows who wrote it! 📝
hint: It is what people call you.

question: Should you write your class and section? 🏫
explanation: Super! Writing your class and section helps the teacher find you easily! 🎒
hint: Think about how teachers know your classroom.

question: What tone should a formal letter have? 😇
explanation: Great job! A formal letter should always sound very polite and respectful! 🎩
hint: It means having good manners.

question: If you are unwell, what is the best subject? 🤒
explanation: Fantastic! 'Sick Leave' quickly tells the teacher that you are resting at home! 🛏️
hint: It has the word 'Sick' in it.

question: If you are going to a cousin's wedding, what is the subject? 🎉
explanation: Awesome! A wedding is a special 'Family Function' or event! 🎈
hint: It is a party with your family.

question: Who do we usually write formal letters to? 👔
explanation: Super! Formal letters are for important people like teachers and principals! 🏫
hint: Think of the adults at school.

question: Which magic word is great for a leave application? ✨
explanation: Great job! 'Please' is a wonderful magic word that shows great respect! 🌟
hint: It is the best magic word for asking politely.

question: Where do we usually put the Date on the letter? 📅
explanation: Brilliant! The date goes near the top so they know exactly when you wrote it! 📆
hint: Look up high on the page.

question: Which is the best way to write the date? 🗓️
explanation: Awesome! Writing the exact day, month, and year is the perfect way! 📆
hint: It has numbers and a month name.

question: What do we ask for in a leave application? ✅
explanation: Super! We are politely asking for permission to take a holiday or rest! 🛏️
hint: We are asking if it is okay to be absent.

question: What does the word 'leave' mean in a school application? 🏖️
explanation: Great job! Here, 'leave' means taking a day off from school to rest or travel! ✈️
hint: It means you will not be at school today.

question: Who usually signs a student's leave application from home? 👨‍👩‍👦
explanation: Awesome! Your parents sign it to show they know you are staying home! 📝
hint: The adults you live with.

question: A paragraph is a group of related... 📝
explanation: Super! A paragraph is a nice group of sentences that talk about one main idea! 💡
hint: They have full stops and capital letters.

question: What is the first sentence of a paragraph called? 🌟
explanation: Great job! The topic sentence introduces what the whole paragraph is about! 📖
hint: It tells you the 'topic'.

question: A topic sentence tells us the... 💡
explanation: Fantastic! It gives the reader the main idea right at the beginning! 🧠
hint: It is the biggest point of the story.

question: All sentences in a paragraph must... 🎯
explanation: Awesome! Every sentence should hold hands and talk about the same topic! 🤝
hint: They need to be about the same thing.

question: How do we usually start writing a new paragraph? ➡️
explanation: Super! We leave a little blank space at the start to show a new paragraph is beginning! 📝
hint: We push the first word in a little bit.

question: What is the little space at the start of a paragraph called? ➡️
explanation: Great job! An 'indent' is that helpful little space we leave before the first word! 📏
hint: It sounds like 'in-dent'.

question: Sentences in a paragraph must be in the right... 🔢
explanation: Awesome! Putting sentences in the correct order helps the story make perfect sense! 🛤️

question: How does a paragraph usually end? 🏁
explanation: Super! A closing sentence beautifully wraps up the main idea! 🎁
hint: It closes the paragraph.

question: What punctuation mark ends a normal sentence? ⏺️
explanation: Great job! A full stop tells the reader to take a breath because the sentence is done! 🛑
hint: It is a tiny dot.

question: What kind of letter starts a new sentence? 🅰️
explanation: Fantastic! Every single sentence begins with a big, strong Capital Letter! 🏛️
hint: A big letter.

question: If the topic is 'My Pet Dog', write sentences about... 🐶
explanation: Awesome! Always stick to the main topic so the reader doesn't get confused! 🎯
hint: Keep writing about the pet mentioned.

question: Should we jump to completely different topics in one paragraph? 🎯
explanation: Super! A good paragraph stays focused on just one single idea! 🔍
hint: Keep it simple and focused.

question: Can a paragraph have just one single word? 📝
explanation: Great job! A paragraph is a team of sentences working together, not just one word! 🤝
hint: It is a group of lines.

question: Formal writing style is very... 👔
explanation: Awesome! Formal writing is very neat, respectful, and polite! 🌟
hint: Like wearing a smart school uniform.

question: What is the 'Greeting' in a letter also called? 👋
explanation: Super! 'Salutation' is the smart grammar word for a greeting! 🎩
hint: It starts with an 'S'.

question: Which of these is a formal greeting? 👔
explanation: Great job! 'Dear Sir' or 'Respected Sir' is perfectly polite and formal! 🏫
hint: It sounds very respectful.

question: What should you write in the body if you have a fever? 🤒
explanation: Awesome! Tell the teacher the true reason so they know you need rest! 🛏️
hint: Tell them about the fever.

question: What important detail goes in the body of a leave application? 🗓️
explanation: Super! The teacher needs to know exactly which dates you will be absent! 📅
hint: The exact days you will be away.

question: In a formal letter, we should avoid using... 🚫
explanation: Great job! Slang words like 'gonna' or 'bro' are for friends, not formal letters! 👔
hint: Casual street words.

question: Do we draw emojis in real school formal letters? ❌
explanation: Fantastic! While emojis are fun on apps, real school letters use clear words instead! 📝
hint: Keep it strictly to words.

question: What is the best paper to use for formal school letters? 📄
explanation: Awesome! A clean, neat sheet of paper shows you care and are respectful! 🌟
hint: Nice and fresh from a notebook.

question: What color pen is best for formal school letters? 🖊️
explanation: Super! Blue or Black ink is the easiest and neatest to read! 📖
hint: Standard school colors.

question: A well-written paragraph should be very easy to... 📖
explanation: Great job! Good writing makes it super easy for anyone to read and understand your ideas! 💡
hint: Think about what eyes do with books.

question: What kinds of words help sentences flow smoothly together? 🌊
explanation: Awesome! Connecting words like 'And', 'Next', and 'Because' join ideas beautifully! 🤝
hint: Words that link things up.

question: Which of these is a great connecting word? ⏭️
explanation: Super! 'Next' tells the reader what is happening right after! ⏱️
hint: It shows what happens after.

question: Which word helps show time order in a paragraph? ⏳
explanation: Great job! 'Then' helps put your sentences in perfect time order! ⏰
hint: It rhymes with 'hen'.

question: To perfectly close a paragraph, we can use the word... 🏁
explanation: Fantastic! 'Finally' is a superb word to start your last closing sentence! 🎁
hint: It means at the very end.

question: A leave application needs to be clear and... 📏
explanation: Awesome! Teachers are busy, so a short and clear application is always the best! ⚡
hint: Not too long.

question: If you miss the school bus, you write an application for... 🚌
explanation: Super! Missing the bus means you just need permission for one single day! 🏫
hint: Just for today.

question: Formal letters are a great way to show our... 🙇‍♂️
explanation: Great job! Using proper formal writing shows wonderful respect to our teachers! 🌟
hint: It means being very polite.
